entries.description: Curated markdown overview of IPTVNetworkHub: pricing, plans, supported devices, setup guides and policy pages, with links to every key page.
Live channel listing covering sports, news, movies, kids, documentary and entertainment categories.
IPTV subscription plans: 1 month at EUR 15, 3 months at EUR 30 and 12 months at EUR 49, each including the full channel guide and a one-day free trial for new subscribers.
Setup instructions for Smart TV, Samsung Smart TV, LG Smart TV, Android, Android TV, Amazon Fire TV Stick, Windows and Mac, plus how to use the supplied login details.
How to contact IPTVNetworkHub support to start a free trial, order a plan or get help with device setup.
